UnitStatement: The estimate-snapshot skill uses a generic TASK shell with no task profile.
The required ScopePath field is the top-level execution root.
The required TaskSkill field must match the estimate-snapshot skill folder name.
AllowedWriteTargets for estimate-snapshot are restricted to the execution root _Estimates directory.
RuntimeOverrides.SCOPE must identify non-empty deliverable IDs, package IDs, or a path glob.
RuntimeOverrides.BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE must be one of QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, PARAMETRIC, or ALLOWANCE.
RuntimeOverrides.CURRENCY must provide an ISO code or project-defined currency token.
RuntimeOverrides.ESTIMATES_ROOT must point to an existing _Estimates directory.
RuntimeOverrides.DECOMPOSITION_PATH may be auto-located under _Decomposition when absent.
The estimate-snapshot skill logs a MISSING_DECOMPOSITION warning when no decomposition markdown is found.
RuntimeOverrides.DEPENDENCY_SOURCES defaults to AUTO, which reads each in-scope deliverable Dependencies.csv file.
RuntimeOverrides.DEPENDENCY_SOURCES may be set to explicit dependency source paths.
RuntimeOverrides.PRICE_SOURCES lists local files or folders containing basis evidence.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_LABEL is a short identifier used in estimate snapshot naming.
RuntimeOverrides.UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER defaults to FALSE and may be TRUE or FALSE.
RuntimeOverrides.FALLBACK_POLICY defaults to STRICT and may also allow allowance or parametric fallback.
RuntimeOverrides.ALLOW_MIXED_METHODS defaults to FALSE and may be TRUE or FALSE.
RuntimeOverrides.ROUNDING defaults to NONE and may use CENT, DOLLAR, or a project-defined value.
RuntimeOverrides.RUN_TIMESTAMP may be omitted because it is runtime-generated by default.
TaskProfile NONE means estimate-snapshot runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
The estimate-snapshot read boundary includes DECOMPOSITION_PATH when provided or auto-located.
When DEPENDENCY_SOURCES is AUTO, the estimate-snapshot read boundary includes each in-scope deliverable Dependencies.csv file.
The estimate-snapshot read boundary includes explicit paths provided in DEPENDENCY_SOURCES.
The estimate-snapshot read boundary includes explicit paths provided in PRICE_SOURCES.
The estimate-snapshot read boundary includes decomposition and deliverable metadata needed to resolve IDs.
The estimate-snapshot skill must not fetch from the internet.
Estimate-snapshot inputs are limited to local inputs.
Estimate-snapshot writes a new immutable EST_OUTPUT_LABEL timestamped folder under ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot updates the _LATEST.md pointer only when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
ESTIMATES_ROOT must already exist before estimate-snapshot runs.
The estimate-snapshot skill does not create the estimating tool root itself.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value QUOTE means vendor-quoted prices from explicit quote lines in vendor documents.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value RATE_TABLE means labor, material, or equipment rates from published tables.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value HISTORICAL means prior project cost data with normalization.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value PARAMETRIC means an approved parametric model with formulas and parameters.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value ALLOWANCE means allowance tables or budgets.
Invalid or missing BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE values cause RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
OUTPUT_LABEL should be short and stable across reruns.
Updating the _LATEST.md pointer is only safe when the invoker has authorized pointer updates.
PRICE_SOURCES are the only authoritative pricing inputs for estimate-snapshot.
Dependencies are not pricing evidence for estimate-snapshot.
Estimate-snapshot does not author a narrative BOE by default.
Step 0 fail-fast validates BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE with tools/validation/validate_enum.py.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE validation failure causes RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS before snapshot pricing proceeds.
CURRENCY must be present for a valid estimate-snapshot run.
ESTIMATES_ROOT must resolve to an existing directory for a valid estimate-snapshot run.
Estimate-snapshot QA requires no files outside ESTIMATES_ROOT to be modified.
Estimate-snapshot must leave deliverable content, _STATUS.md, decomposition outputs, and dependency registers untouched.
Every estimate-snapshot run must create a new EST_OUTPUT_LABEL timestamped snapshot folder under ESTIMATES_ROOT.
A snapshot folder must exist even when the run ends FAILED_INPUTS or blocked.
Estimate-snapshot must not overwrite an existing snapshot folder.
QA requires BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE to be one of QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, PARAMETRIC, or ALLOWANCE.
An invalid or missing BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value produces RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
Run_Context.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
Summary.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
QA_Report.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
Source_Index.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
Decision_Log.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
Assumptions_Log.md is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
WBS_CBS_Matrix.csv is a required estimate-snapshot artifact.
Detail.csv must contain the canonical estimate line-item columns when it exists.
Detail.csv Method values must be QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, ALLOWANCE, or PARAMETRIC.
Detail.csv Confidence values must be LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.
Detail.csv Currency values must match the brief CURRENCY.
Allowance and parametric Detail.csv rows must use Qty=1.
Allowance and parametric Detail.csv rows must use Unit=LS.
Allowance and parametric Detail.csv rows must set UnitRate equal to Amount.
Every priced row must carry a best-effort SourceRef or explicitly state location TBD.
QA_Report.md must report provenance completeness as a percentage.
QA_Report.md must list the top missing-source offenders.
Priced rows must not carry invented sources.
Priced rows must not cite sources outside PRICE_SOURCES.
HIGH confidence applies to human-confirmed values and vendor-quoted values.
MEDIUM confidence applies to stable published rate-table derivations, normalized historical data, and approved parametric model outputs.
LOW confidence applies to allowance-table values, sparse historical analogs, and weakly grounded parametric outputs.
Allowance-derived amounts must not receive HIGH confidence.
Parametric-derived amounts must not receive HIGH confidence.
HIGH confidence on a QUOTE-method row requires an attached SourceRef to the vendor quote.
Confidence assignments must be consistent with the row Method value.
QA_Report.md must declare exactly one RUN_STATUS.
RUN_STATUS=OK means totals are meaningful and no critical input gaps remain.
RUN_STATUS=WARNINGS means totals exist but material TBDs or assumptions remain.
RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS means basis inputs or pricing sources are insufficient for meaningful totals.
A snapshot is publishable when RUN_STATUS is OK or WARNINGS with clearly bounded gaps.
Basis-consistency deviations must be explicitly approved and logged when basis checks do not pass.
Publishable snapshots report provenance completeness and actionable top gaps.
Publishable snapshots make scope coverage explicit with included, excluded, and blocked counts and reasons.
Publishable snapshots require no writes outside ESTIMATES_ROOT.
When ALLOW_MIXED_METHODS is FALSE, every Detail.csv Method should equal BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE unless fallback is explicitly permitted and logged.
When ALLOW_MIXED_METHODS is TRUE, QA_Report.md must include the method mix histogram.
Deliverables blocked by missing input information are listed in Blockers.md or blocker_report.csv.
Each blocker must cite the dependency row that raised it.
EstimateImpactClass may be passed through as a hint when present in dependency rows.
EstimateImpactClass must not be invented.
Missing PRICE_SOURCES or empty basis evidence results in TBD amounts and RUN_STATUS WARNINGS or FAILED_INPUTS.
Missing decomposition logs MISSING_DECOMPOSITION in QA_Report.md and Run_Context.md.
A run with missing decomposition proceeds with degraded ID and path validation.
Invalid BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE causes RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS and no pricing attempt.
Attempting to overwrite an existing snapshot folder halts the run as a tooling failure.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports RUN_STATUS=OK.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports the snapshot folder path.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports counts for in-scope deliverables, priced rows, and blocked deliverables.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports the provenance completeness percentage.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports the method mix histogram even when a single method is used.
A clean estimate-snapshot run lists the PRICE_SOURCES that were consumed.
A clean estimate-snapshot run reports that no writes occurred outside ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot produces an immutable estimate snapshot under the estimating tool root for a bounded scope.
Each estimate-snapshot run writes a new timestamped snapshot folder.
Estimate-snapshot snapshots include provenance-first line items, WBS-by-CBS rollup matrix, QA reporting, and run context logs.
Estimate-snapshot does not author a narrative Basis of Estimate by default.
Estimate-snapshot requires a validated BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE enum as an explicit input.
The BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value drives default behaviors, method tagging, and QA consistency checks.
Estimate-snapshot is suitable for TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
ScopePath is a required estimate-snapshot input and is the execution root.
TaskSkill is a required estimate-snapshot input and must be estimate-snapshot.
AllowedWriteTargets is required and must target the execution root _Estimates directory.
RuntimeOverrides.SCOPE is required and may contain deliverable IDs, package IDs, or a path glob.
RuntimeOverrides.BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is required and must be QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, PARAMETRIC, or ALLOWANCE.
RuntimeOverrides.CURRENCY is required and may be an ISO-like code or project-defined currency token.
RuntimeOverrides.ESTIMATES_ROOT is required and must already exist.
If DECOMPOSITION_PATH is absent, estimate-snapshot attempts to locate the most recent decomposition markdown under _Decomposition.
If no decomposition is found, estimate-snapshot records a MISSING_DECOMPOSITION warning and proceeds with degraded ID and path validation.
DEPENDENCY_SOURCES defaults to AUTO or may provide explicit dependency register and snapshot paths.
PRICE_SOURCES contains quote, rate table, historical dataset, parametric model, or allowance table inputs.
OUTPUT_LABEL is an optional short label for snapshot naming.
UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is optional and defaults to FALSE.
FALLBACK_POLICY is optional and defaults to STRICT.
ALLOW_MIXED_METHODS is optional and defaults to FALSE.
ROUNDING is optional and defaults to NONE.
RUN_TIMESTAMP is optional and otherwise generated at runtime.
Estimate-snapshot reads DECOMPOSITION_PATH when it is provided or auto-located.
Estimate-snapshot reads each in-scope deliverable Dependencies.csv when DEPENDENCY_SOURCES is AUTO.
Estimate-snapshot reads explicit paths provided in DEPENDENCY_SOURCES.
Estimate-snapshot reads explicit PRICE_SOURCES paths.
Estimate-snapshot reads decomposition and deliverable metadata needed to resolve IDs.
Estimate-snapshot must use only local inputs and must not fetch from the internet.
Estimate-snapshot writes a new EST_OUTPUT_LABEL timestamped folder under ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot may update _LATEST.md only when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
Estimate-snapshot must not write outside ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot must not modify project truth files.
Estimate-snapshot prefers tools/validation/validate_enum.py for BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE validation at Step 0.
Estimate-snapshot prefers tools/scaffolding/create_snapshot_folder.sh to create immutable snapshot folders.
Estimate-snapshot prefers tools/scaffolding/update_latest_pointer.sh only when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
Estimate-snapshot disallows writes outside ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot disallows modifying deliverable content, lifecycle files, decomposition outputs, and dependency registers.
Estimate-snapshot disallows overwriting an existing snapshot folder.
Estimate-snapshot disallows internet fetching.
Estimate-snapshot disallows treating prior _Estimates snapshots as pricing sources unless explicitly included in PRICE_SOURCES.
Step 0 resolves the tool root to ESTIMATES_ROOT or the execution root _Estimates directory.
Step 0 validates BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE before proceeding.
Step 0 creates an immutable estimate snapshot folder.
Step 0 updates _LATEST.md only when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
Step 1 reads DECOMPOSITION_PATH when provided or auto-located under the execution root _Decomposition directory.
Step 1 extracts package IDs, deliverable IDs, labels, and optional hints from decomposition.
Step 1 uses CBSHint, EstimateMethodHint, StageHint, and ContextEnvelope only when present.
Step 1 records MISSING_DECOMPOSITION in QA and Run_Context.md when decomposition is missing.
Step 1 proceeds best-effort with degraded validation when decomposition is missing.
Step 2 expands SCOPE into a concrete deliverable list.
Step 2 records DeliverableID, PackageID, Path, InScope, and notes in Scope_Resolved.csv or Run_Context.md.
Step 3 reads each in-scope deliverable Dependencies.csv when DEPENDENCY_SOURCES is AUTO.
Step 3 uses dependency evidence to identify prerequisites and information gaps that block meaningful estimating.
Step 3 treats EstimateImpactClass as a hint only when it is present.
Step 3 emits Blockers.md or blocker_report.csv for unresolved inputs by deliverable with evidence references.
Dependencies inform readiness only and are not pricing evidence.
Step 4 indexes each PRICE_SOURCES entry in Source_Index.md with path, source type, parsing notes, and support boundaries.
If PRICE_SOURCES are empty or unusable, estimate-snapshot records TBD amounts instead of guessing prices.
Empty or unusable PRICE_SOURCES produce FAILED_INPUTS or WARNINGS according to the specification.
Step 4 avoids recursive ingestion of prior _Estimates snapshots unless explicitly listed in PRICE_SOURCES.
Step 5 proposes at least one line item per in-scope deliverable unless the deliverable is blocked.
Step 5 assigns WBS_PackageID and WBS_DeliverableID from decomposition when available.
Step 5 assigns CBS from explicit CBSHint, a documented deterministic rule, or TBD.
Step 5 prices line items using only PRICE_SOURCES evidence.
When BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is QUOTE, Step 5 assigns Method=QUOTE.
When BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is RATE_TABLE, Step 5 assigns Method=RATE_TABLE.
When BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is HISTORICAL, Step 5 assigns Method=HISTORICAL.
When BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is PARAMETRIC, Step 5 assigns Method=PARAMETRIC.
When BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE is ALLOWANCE, Step 5 assigns Method=ALLOWANCE.
Step 5 enforces ALLOW_MIXED_METHODS and FALLBACK_POLICY.
If basis evidence is missing and fallback is not allowed, Step 5 sets Amount=TBD and logs a QA warning.
Step 5 populates SourceRef on every priced row with a file reference or a log entry reference.
Step 5 uses location TBD and flags QA when row provenance is unknown.
Step 5 applies Qty=1, Unit=LS, and UnitRate=Amount for allowance and parametric rows.
Step 6 produces WBS_CBS_Matrix.csv with totals by WBS_PackageID, WBS_DeliverableID, CBS, and Currency.
Step 6 produces Summary.md with basis configuration, totals, warnings, and blockers.
Step 7 produces QA_Report.md.
QA_Report.md includes Detail.csv schema validity and enum validation results.
QA_Report.md includes coverage for deliverables covered, missing, and blocked.
QA_Report.md includes provenance completeness.
QA_Report.md includes basis-consistency checks.
QA_Report.md includes blocker counts when dependency evidence is available.
QA_Report.md describes what to fix for a cleaner rerun.
QA_Report.md declares RUN_STATUS as OK, WARNINGS, or FAILED_INPUTS.
Decision_Log.md records defaults applied, fallback uses, and scope-resolution decisions.
Assumptions_Log.md records explicit assumptions with IDs.
Risk_Register.md is optional and only emitted when risks are explicit or implied by missing inputs.
Change_Log.md records changes against a referenced prior snapshot.
Run_Context.md is a required snapshot artifact.
Summary.md is a required snapshot artifact.
QA_Report.md is a required snapshot artifact.
Source_Index.md is a required snapshot artifact.
Decision_Log.md is a required snapshot artifact.
Assumptions_Log.md is a required snapshot artifact.
WBS_CBS_Matrix.csv is a required snapshot artifact.
Detail.csv is recommended and required for full runs where pricing sources support meaningful totals.
Scope_Resolved.csv is emitted when scope expansion is non-trivial.
blocker_report.csv or Blockers.md is emitted when dependencies are used.
Risk_Register.md is an optional estimate-snapshot artifact.
Change_Log.md is an optional estimate-snapshot artifact.
Run_Brief.md is recommended for audit when a brief is provided by the invoker.
BOE.md is not required by default.
A narrative BOE may be emitted only when explicitly requested by the invoker.
A narrative BOE must be derived only from run inputs and sources.
Detail.csv mandatory columns are LineID, CBS, WBS_PackageID, WBS_DeliverableID, Description, Qty, Unit, UnitRate, Amount, Currency, Method, SourceRef, Confidence, and Notes.
Allowance and parametric Detail.csv rows use Qty=1, Unit=LS, and UnitRate=Amount.
WBS_CBS_Matrix.csv minimum columns are WBS_PackageID, WBS_DeliverableID, CBS, Currency, Amount_Total, LineCount, ProvenanceCompletenessPct, and Notes.
Run_Context.md minimum fields include run configuration, scope, sources, policies, rounding, and warnings.
BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE enum discipline requires exactly QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, PARAMETRIC, or ALLOWANCE.
Any invalid BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value produces FAILED_INPUTS at Step 0.
Snapshot immutability requires each estimate-snapshot run to write a new snapshot folder.
Estimate-snapshot must never overwrite an existing snapshot folder.
Write quarantine allows writes only under ESTIMATES_ROOT.
Estimate-snapshot must never modify deliverable content, lifecycle files, decomposition outputs, or dependency registers.
Provenance-first discipline requires every Detail.csv priced row to carry SourceRef or location TBD.
Every Detail.csv priced row carries Method and Confidence.
Estimate-snapshot must record TBD and surface QA gaps when values cannot be substantiated.
Estimate-snapshot must not guess unsubstantiated quantity, rate, currency, scope boundary, or dependency claims.
Human-confirmed and vendor-quoted values earn HIGH confidence.
Parametric values earn MEDIUM or LOW confidence.
Parametric and allowance table values must not receive HIGH confidence.
Dependencies inform readiness and blockers only.
Unit rates must come from PRICE_SOURCES.
Prior _Estimates snapshots must not be pricing sources unless explicitly listed in PRICE_SOURCES.
Estimate-snapshot outputs should be deterministic for identical inputs apart from timestamps and ordering normalizations.
QA expects BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE validation before any writes occur.
QA expects a new snapshot folder even when inputs block the run.
QA expects Run_Context.md, Summary.md, QA_Report.md, and Source_Index.md to exist.
When Detail.csv exists, QA checks schema, Method values, and allowance or parametric conventions.
QA expects every priced row to have SourceRef or location TBD.
QA expects method mix to match BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE unless mixed methods or fallback deviations are allowed and logged.
QA_Report.md must declare RUN_STATUS as OK, WARNINGS, or FAILED_INPUTS.
QA expects no files outside ESTIMATES_ROOT to be modified.
The preferred first tool validates BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE at Step 0 and fails with FAILED_INPUTS if invalid.
The preferred second tool creates the immutable snapshot folder with canonical naming.
The preferred third tool updates _LATEST.md only when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
Reasoning and file-write operations load decomposition, enumerate scope, load evidence, generate details and rollups, and emit QA artifacts.
TASK-enforced estimate-snapshot tools include python3 tools/validation/validate_enum.py.
TASK-enforced estimate-snapshot tools include bash tools/scaffolding/create_snapshot_folder.sh.
TASK-enforced estimate-snapshot tools include bash tools/scaffolding/update_latest_pointer.sh.
No additional operational helpers are declared beyond the TASK-enforced estimate-snapshot tools.
Deterministic tools handle enum validation, snapshot folder creation, and pointer management.
Reasoning handles scope resolution, evidence loading, line-item generation, rollups, provenance assignment, blocker identification, and QA reporting.
Estimate-snapshot disallows hidden reliance on tools outside the declared list unless the human expands AllowedTools.
Estimate-snapshot disallows modifying deliverable folders, decomposition outputs, dependency registers, and lifecycle files.
Estimate-snapshot disallows prior _Estimates snapshots as pricing sources unless explicitly included in PRICE_SOURCES.
Estimate-snapshot writes only under ESTIMATES_ROOT into a new EST_OUTPUT_LABEL timestamped snapshot folder.
Estimate-snapshot optionally updates ESTIMATES_ROOT _LATEST.md when UPDATE_LATEST_POINTER is TRUE.
Estimate-snapshot does not modify project truth, deliverable content, lifecycle files, decomposition outputs, or dependency registers.
